craft_notes: Sthāyin: sound-list (four sites → brahman). Sanskrit: anāhate pātrakarṇe...param brahmādhigacchati → L4 keeps four sites colon-comma rhythm. Rows: row 2 (bathed→attained). Close: attained (fruit of sound). Rejected: 'nāda-darśana' label — killed: sites kept literal; 'ear' alone — vessel-ear kept.

lines: bathed in word-brahman — supreme brahman attained.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anāhate pātrakarṇe 'bhagnaśabde sariddrute | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahmādhigacchati

reads_against.argmap: Where does the knower attain? → Bathed in word-brahman through those sounds, supreme brahman is attained.
c1_essence: Unstruck, vessel-ear, broken sound: word-brahman bathed, brahman attained.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
